title.zh: 【希腊议会通过加密货币资本利得税法案，税率为 10%】
title.en: 【希腊议会通过加密货币资本利得税法案，税率为 10%】

current_state.zh: Greece's parliament passed legislation imposing a 10% tax on cryptocurrency capital gains, exempting annual gains up to €500, establishing the country's first comprehensive legal framework for crypto asset taxation with detailed implementation and audit rules to follow.
current_state.en: Greece's parliament passed legislation imposing a 10% tax on cryptocurrency capital gains, exempting annual gains up to €500, establishing the country's first comprehensive legal framework for crypto asset taxation with detailed implementation and audit rules to follow.
